title: Tanium addressed an insertion of sensitive information into log file vulnerability in Threat Response. (CVE-2026-108328)
description: Tanium Threat Response had a vulnerability allowing insertion of sensitive information into log files. This issue could lead to unauthorized disclosure of sensitive data through logs. The vulnerability has a medium severity score of 4.2 and requires high privileges and user interaction to exploit. No public exploits or known active exploitation have been reported. No affected versions or patch information are provided.
